# sophosfirewall_interface (Data Source)

Looks up an existing network interface by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sophosfirewall_interface" "port1" {
  name = "Port1"
}

output "port1_address" {
  value = data.sophosfirewall_interface.port1.ipv4.address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the interface.

### Read-Only

- `bridge` (Attributes) Bridge settings. Required when `type` is `bridge`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bridge))
- `description` (String) Description. Only applicable to bridge interfaces.
- `hardware_name` (String) Hardware name of the interface. Required by the firewall for bridge and LAG interfaces; derived automatically for VLANs. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `ipv4` (Attributes) IPv4 configuration. Omit to leave it unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))
- `ipv6` (Attributes) IPv6 configuration. Omit to leave it unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6))
- `lag` (Attributes) Link aggregation settings. Required when `type` is `lag`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lag))
- `mss` (Number) Maximum segment size (536-8960).
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum transmission unit (576-9000).
- `type` (String) Interface type. One of `vlan`, `bridge`, `lag`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `vlan` (Attributes) VLAN settings. Required when `type` is `vlan`. Changing this forces a new resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlan))
- `zone` (String) Zone of the interface. Only applicable to VLAN interfaces.

<a id="nestedatt--bridge"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bridge`

Read-Only:

- `filter_ethernet_frames` (Boolean) Filter Ethernet frames by type.
- `filter_vlans` (Boolean) Filter VLAN traffic.
- `mac_aging` (Number) MAC address aging time in seconds (0-65535).
- `members` (Attributes List) Bridge members (at least two). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bridge--members))
- `permit_arp_broadcast` (Boolean) Permit ARP broadcasts.
- `routing` (Boolean) Route traffic between the bridge and other interfaces.
- `stp` (Boolean) Enable Spanning Tree Protocol.
- `stp_max_age` (Number) STP maximum age in seconds (6-40).

<a id="nestedatt--bridge--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bridge.members`

Read-Only:

- `interface` (String) Name of the member interface.
- `zone` (String) Zone of the member.



<a id="nestedatt--ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Interface address with prefix length, e.g. `192.0.2.1/24`. Required for `static`; reported by the firewall for `dhcp`.
- `assignment_type` (String) How the address is assigned. One of `static`, `dhcp`.
- `gateway_address` (String) Gateway address. Only applicable to `static`.
- `gateway_name` (String) Name of the gateway.


<a id="nestedatt--ipv6"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv6`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Interface address with prefix length, e.g. `2001:db8::1/64`. Required for `static`; reported by the firewall for `dhcp`.
- `assignment_type` (String) How the address is assigned. One of `static`, `dhcp`.
- `gateway_address` (String) Gateway address. Only applicable to `static`.
- `gateway_name` (String) Name of the gateway.


<a id="nestedatt--lag"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lag`

Read-Only:

- `load_balance_method` (String) Transmit hash policy in `lacp8023ad` mode. One of `layer2`, `layer2And3`, `layer3And4`.
- `members` (Set of String) Names of the member interfaces.
- `mode` (String) Bonding mode. One of `activeBackup`, `lacp8023ad`.
- `primary_interface` (String) Primary member in `activeBackup` mode.


<a id="nestedatt--vlan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlan`

Read-Only:

- `parent_interface` (String) Name of the parent interface, e.g. `Port2`.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN ID (1-4094).
